Alex (Support): @Maya heads-up: Sparrow trial (3 seats) hitting auth 401s and webhook drops. Trial ends in 6 days. Ticket #83421 created :rotating_light:
Maya (CS): copy. paste the latest error and customer contact so we can escalate to CS priority. will draft comms plan. :eyes:
Alex (Support): errors:
```
2025-06-12T09:02:11Z ERROR Auth: 401 Unauthorized - refresh_token invalid (tenant: sparrow)
2025-06-12T09:03:00Z WARN Webhook: 502 Bad Gateway -> retries exhausted
TraceID: trc-83421
```
Contact: emma@sparrow.ai (Head of Data). They've retried onboarding twice and saw missing events during a demo. DevOps-bot: traces -> https://internal.redwood/logs/83421
Maya (CS): triage plan (short): 1) 15m intro today to confirm consent + scope (Emma) 2) hands-on enablement tomorrow to regen creds + validate webhooks 3) short-term mitigation: pause retries, run manual backfill. If backfill fails, escalate to eng-oncall. Owners: @Priya (Onboarding) for runbook, @Alex (Support) to perform token regen after consent.
Priya (Onboarding): I'll prepare a one-page runbook (permissions + regen steps) and join enablement tomorrow at 10:30 PT.
Alex (Support): Emma available 2pm PT today for 15m. I'll start regen after the sync and share creds via vault link.
Maya (CS): I'll send the warm intro + calendar invites now and follow up with a customer summary after enablement. Renewal health update by Friday EOD. Tagging owners: @Priya / @Alex. Closing loop unless new info :thumbsup:
